title: Reconcile the first AVD entry across avd-setup.ps1, emulators-start.ps1, and adb-connect-wsl.sh
rule: Tier-2 AREA NOTE: drift between duplicated configs
why: avd-setup.ps1's own $MATRIX creates the port-5554 device as API 24 on a 'Nexus 5' profile named `lt_api24_nexus5`. But emulators-start.ps1's $ALL_AVDS and adb-connect-wsl.sh's EXPECTED_NAMES/EXPECTED_APIS both expect an AVD literally named `lt_api28_pixel2` (API 28, Pixel 2) at that same port — and both agree with EACH OTHER, only avd-setup.ps1 disagrees. All 4 other matrix rows (29/31/34/36.1) match perfectly across all 3 scripts. Following avd-setup.ps1's own documented next step ('Start all 5: .\tool\emulators-start.ps1') on a fresh machine launches `emulator -avd lt_api28_pixel2`, which was never created — that emulator slot fails to boot, and adb-connect-wsl.sh's health check for it reports NOT FOUND.
recommendation: Pick one name/API/device-profile for the port-5554 slot and make all 3 scripts agree — most likely revert avd-setup.ps1's first matrix row back to api=28/device='Pixel 2'/name='lt_api28_pixel2' to match the other two (already-agreeing) scripts, unless the API-24 floor change was intentional, in which case propagate it to emulators-start.ps1 and adb-connect-wsl.sh instead.
acceptance_criteria: The AVD name/API/port for the first device slot is identical across avd-setup.ps1, emulators-start.ps1, and adb-connect-wsl.sh.
Running avd-setup.ps1 followed by emulators-start.ps1 boots all 5 emulators, verified by adb-connect-wsl.sh reporting 5/5 ONLINE.
mergedFrom: Consolidate the 3 different hardcoded ADB binary paths across driver.py, adb-connect-wsl.sh, and vision_find_pass.js
